items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Joins A Major Enterprise AI Infrastructure Build
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) announced a new partnership with Cisco to supply high density liquid and air cooled compute systems for AI infrastructure. The company’s systems will be integrated into Cisco’s Secure AI Factory architecture, which uses NVIDIA technologies for enterprise, neocloud and sovereign cloud customers. The collaboration broadens Super Micro Computer’s access to rack scale and dense GPU systems that are validated for Cisco’s AI offerings. Consider broadening your...

items.title: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock is back in focus after the company and partners Cisco and HUMAIN outlined plans to deploy up to 250 MW of AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia starting in 2027. Despite the Saudi AI announcement and other partnerships around secure AI infrastructure, Advanced Micro Devices’ recent share price has eased, with the 7-day share price return down 4.08% and the 90-day share price return down 15.28%. At the same time, the year-to-date share price return is up 105.67%...
